issues.on_page: Taxes: Other 18,217.45 (Statement of Activities p2: Homestead/other)
issues.issue: The report labels it 'Homestead/other', so it is a mix of homestead and other credits or taxes with no breakdown. Homestead Exemption is a reasonable guess for the dominant part, but it is not established; 'other taxes' is also defensible. The same applies to detail[2] (General 11,424.20) and detail[16] (Street 6,793.25).

The Statement of Activities (p2) shows this as Operating Grants and Contributions (General Government 4,307.47, Culture and Recreation 44,070.70) and does not name the grantor. It may be government grants rather than private donations.

The Statement of Activities (p2) counts this in Water charges for services (195,973.29). Utility Charges would match the Water Fund's other charge line. Its printed label is 'Other', so the current category is defensible.

issues.on_page: Governmental funds statement p3 (Total 107,341.82, equal to the government-wide governmental column): Restricted 15.57, Assigned: Street 93,399.09, Assigned: Library 38,717.38, Unassigned (24,790.22)
issues.issue: User rule 2026-10-27: cash-basis reports take governmental balance-sheet lines from the governmental funds statement (fund balance by classification) when its totals equal the government-wide figures, as they do here. The extraction used the government-wide Total column instead (amounts and totals are correct as printed). The person should decide whether to restate the governmental part by classification.

issues.on_page: General column on p4 omits the Charges for services line; Total Receipts 512,413.99 is 2,485.94 above the printed lines
issues.issue: This fund-column amount is derived: it is the General Fund Total Receipts gap, and the line is printed only in the comparative total on p10. It is marked computed and recorded in report_discrepancies, and the Statement of Activities (p2) confirms 2,485.94 of charges for services.
